chunks: He said: You have taken idols in place of God out of mutual affection in this life, then on the Day of Resurrection some of you will disown some others and curse some of you some others, and your abode will be Hell, and you will have no helper.

key_terms.وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ: And your abode is the Fire

ai.seo_question: Why did people worship idols according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the fragility of worldly social bonds forged through polytheism, contrasting them with the spiritual unity of the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores that idolatry serves as a temporary social glue that dissolves into mutual cursing on the Day of Judgment, where each group abandons its idols and each other. This reflects the broader Quranic theme that false deities lack the power to intercede or provide salvation, leaving humanity alone before Allah.
